newsitem.title: CHINA: LAI SUN DEV APPLIES FOR LAI FUNG LISTING.
newsitem.headline: LAI SUN DEV APPLIES FOR LAI FUNG LISTING.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Thursday it had made a formal application on Wednesday to the Hong Kong stock exchange regarding a proposed spin-off of its China property operations Lai Fung Holdings Ltd.
"Preparation for the proposed listing is still in progress and details of the proposed listing have not yet finalised," it said in a statement.

Lai Sun said its wholly owned Lai Fung Overseas Finance Ltd had in January 1994 issued US$150 million convertible bonds convertible into shares of Lai Fung. The bonds will be redeemed on February 5, 1998, it said.
